
SASBDB entry SASDWX6  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDWX6/)

Publication: none in the SASBDB record (project: Structural insights into the nature of static and dynamic apoferritin dimers)
DOI:         none

Files are SASBDB downloads (sasbdb.org/media/): experimental_data/SASDWX6.dat, SASDWX6_fit1.fit, SASDWX6_fit1_model1.pdb. Nothing was modified.
Buffer (137 mM NaCl, 2.7 mM KCl, 10 mM phosphate, 0.9 mM CaCl2, 0.5 mM MgCl2, pH 7.4),
20 C and 0.1033 nm: SASBDB only; no paper was found. The .fit is CRYSOL, header "Chi^2: 1.257"
(a chi2, recomputed). The model file is the same as that of SASDWY6
(byte-identical), with 816 A and 816 B altloc records.
